158.label: Pre-grasp Hover
158.description: Steering F158 produces hovering / pre-grasp behaviour: the gripper approaches the target but lingers above it, repeatedly aligning instead of closing. At alpha=100 the robot eventually grasps in some tasks.

399.label: Grasp Acquisition
399.description: Steering F399 brings the robot near to a grasp, where it appears to believe the grasp has succeeded -- lifting the object into the air and then cycling this behavior repeatedly. Consistent with the feature's meaning as a grasp-acquisition signal.
